import subprocess
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from handoff_demo.branch_policy import encode_event


class HiddenTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_the_current_stable_branch_contract_is_followed(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        branch = subprocess.check_output(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
        self.assertEqual(branch, "stable")
        self.assertEqual((root / "branch-marker.txt").read_text().strip(), "stable")
        other = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "next:branch-marker.txt"], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
        self.assertEqual(other, "next")
        for name, value in (("ready", "yes"), ("failed", "no")):
            self.assertEqual(encode_event(name, value), f"{name}|{value}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
